prompt: Fixed camera, single character, full-body shot. The martial artist begins in a side-facing open-palm guard. He slowly crosses both arms in front of his chest, then circles one hand upward past his face and over his head while extending the other hand downward. He smoothly turns to face the camera and fully opens both arms to the sides. He brings both hands back together in a palm-to-palm position in front of his chest, separates them, turns back to the side, and returns to the initial open-palm guard. The movement is slow, fluid, controlled, and evenly paced. Both feet remain mostly planted. Repeat the complete sequence three times at the same rhythm.

Fixed camera, single character, full-body shot. The martial artist begins in a fighting guard and quickly lowers his center of gravity. One leg bends to support the body while the other sweeps close to the ground in a complete spinning low sweep. Using the momentum of the sweep, he rises into the air, rotates his body, and fully extends one leg upward into a high kick. He retracts the kicking leg and lands in a stable stance, crosses both arms in front of his chest, steps forward into an open-palm strike, and finally returns to the original fighting guard. Keep the exact action order: lower the body, spinning low sweep, rising aerial turn, high kick, stable landing, crossed-arm finish, forward palm strike, and return to guard. Repeat the complete sequence three times at the same rhythm.

Fixed camera, single character, full-body shot. The martial artist begins in an open-palm guard. He steps diagonally forward to gather momentum, crosses and switches his foot placement, and performs a fast body turn. After the turn, he drops into a stable bow stance and delivers one powerful straight punch toward the camera. He briefly holds the impact, retracts the fist, shifts his weight backward, and returns to the initial open-palm guard. The movement is continuous, grounded, and powerful. Perform the sequence only once. Do not kick, jump, or move outside the camera frame.

Fixed camera, single character, full-body shot. The martial artist maintains a narrow stance with a stable lower body and begins in a Wing Chun guard with both hands protecting the centerline. He performs alternating tan sao, guarding hand movements, and short-range vertical punches. His upper body makes subtle rotations to redirect force while both forearms alternate between defense and attack along the centerline. He finishes by drawing both hands back into the initial asking-hand guard. The motion is restrained, precise, and moderately paced. Footwork is limited to small weight shifts. Repeat the complete combination three times.

Fixed camera, single character, full-body shot. The martial artist begins in a Wing Chun fighting guard and launches a rapid sequence of alternating straight punches along the centerline. The combination includes one pak sao deflection followed by a turning bong sao defense. He advances with a short pressure step, immediately stabilizes his center of gravity, and finishes with one arm attacking while the other protects the centerline. He then withdraws half a step and returns to the initial guard. Keep the punches compact, rhythmic, and precise, with relaxed shoulders and no large jumps. Repeat the full combination three times.

Fixed camera, single character, full-body shot. The martial artist begins in a frontal Wing Chun asking-hand guard. He turns slightly to redirect an incoming attack, blocks with the lead hand, and immediately delivers a straight punch with the rear hand. He continues with a fast combination of pak sao, vertical punches, and a close-range elbow strike. His weight shifts quickly between both feet while the hips rotate subtly to support each technique. He finishes by stepping diagonally forward into a controlled final pose, then smoothly returns to the frontal guard. The movement is fast, compact, and accurate. Perform one complete sequence only.

Fixed camera, single character, full-body shot. The female character begins in a relaxed side-facing stance. Her arms swing naturally with the rhythm as she steps to one side and raises one knee. She shifts her hips, changes feet, and performs a light, compact turn. After landing, she opens both arms beside her body, adding playful shoulder and head movements, then returns to the starting pose. The animation should feel lively, soft, playful, and dance-like while remaining near the original position. Repeat the complete sequence three times at an even rhythm.

Fixed camera, single character, full-body shot. The female fighter begins in a guarded ready stance. She lowers her center of gravity into a wide stance and delivers alternating punches toward the left and right diagonal directions. She then steps forward, turns her body, performs a horizontal forearm block, rotates back, and delivers one powerful straight punch. Her lower body remains stable while her clothing follows the turns with natural secondary motion. She brings her feet back together and returns to the initial ready stance. Repeat the complete attack-and-defense combination three times.

Fixed camera, single character, full-body shot. The female fighter begins in a side-facing combat stance. She draws her arms backward to prepare the attack, raises one knee, and rapidly rotates her hips into a horizontal spinning kick. The attacking leg fully extends while the supporting foot turns naturally with the body. After the kick, she retracts the leg, lands with control, raises both arms to protect her upper body, and returns to the initial stance. The movement is clean, explosive, and well balanced. Perform the sequence only once. Do not add a second kick.
